diagnosis.reasoning: Request rate and prompt-token rate tripled (+200%/+221%) with identical request shape, unchanged prefix-cache hit rate, zero preemptions, and KV usage still low at 0.27 — so no internal mechanism is degraded. The TTFT blowup is almost entirely queue time (13.4s of 18.5s) with running batch and iteration tokens scaling up proportionally, i.e. admitted load exceeding serving throughput. Queueing is the proximate path to the SLI and batch growth/prefill inflation are downstream of the arrival surge, not defects.
